How does Manna™ work?

Manna™ transforms your collected data and measurements into actionable insights, linking grain characteristics to end-product performance and quality.

Manna™ intelligence is far more advanced than standardized analysis alone. Manna™ has analyzed thousands of datapoints to reveal the complex relations between grain biochemistry and food functionality.

Manna™ AI bases its actionable recommendations and insights on a robust data source tailored to you by seamlessly integrating your grain data with proprietary Equinom grain research.

Imagine if you could predict bread quality by analyzing a wheat-grain sample. Picture maximizing your protein extraction from peas by evaluating the variety.

Manna™ AI replaces trial and error with precision.
